name: shield
description: AI-powered security scanner for git repos. Ships the shield CLI, an MCP server, and a REST/dashboard server over a package-owned local SQLite store.

serviceSurfaces.name: shield-api
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: shield-serve exposes /api/* over localhost only and does not yet serve the contract topology (GET /health, GET /ready, GET /version) or publish an OpenAPI document. Declaring it supported would assert endpoints this build does not answer.
